cases.query: This settings page reads like AI wrote it: a tiny uppercase label over every heading and a subtitle under each one that repeats it. Clean it up.
Remove the slop from our dashboard: a gradient headline, glowing cards, and badges on everything.
Every card on the projects screen sits inside another card and has a colored stripe down its left edge. Get rid of the template look without changing our design system.
The signed-in onboarding screens were generated and are full of filler: 'unlock', 'seamless', emoji bullets, and a Get started button on every card. Strip it out.
Run an AI-tell sweep on the billing page and remove what you find, with before and after evidence.
Claude built this inbox and every empty state says 'Nothing here yet!' while each card ends in 'Learn more'. Find the generated copy and fix it.
The gutters differ between the settings and billing pages, and the Save button wraps at 390. Fix the spacing and the wrap.
Headings use different sizes on every page and the button corners look pinched inside cards. Bring the screen to a clean baseline.
Write the headings, field hints, and empty-state copy for the new invite screen before we build it.
Agents keep hand-rolling buttons and cards. Rebuild the settings screen from our shadcn components and report what was reused.
Hardcoded hex colors and one-off shadow values are multiplying across the app. Map them to tokens and add a check that keeps them out.
Show me three options for the usage card behind a picker so I can choose one.
